The tip amount on an order of $84.50 at a rate of 15% is calculated as follows:

\[ 0.15 \times 84.50 = 12.675 \]

Rounding to the nearest cent, the tip is $12.68.

According to the service charge policy found in our internal documentation, there is no service charge applied to orders under $100. Since the order amount of $84.50 is below this threshold, no additional service charge will be added.

Therefore, the final total the customer owes is:

\[ \text{Order Amount} + \text{Tip} = 84.50 + 12.68 = 97.18 \]

The customer owes a total of $97.18.
